abilities.name: NullAbility
abilities.verification: Faithfully unusable: the public ABI rejects id 0 like NativeAOT, while 18 retained clone-instantiation goldens preserve the shipped prefab failure caused by its missing FixTransform; supplied empty-callback InstantAbility graphs are separately covered.

abilities.name: Random
abilities.verification: Spawn-time replacement matches GameSessionHandler across exact seeded draws, ids 2..38, authored cooldowns, and the all-Random offensive fallback; random_ability_ab compares 72 NativeAOT/Rust slots.

abilities.name: Grenade
abilities.verification: grenade_ability_ab and grenade_fuse_ab each match 700 NativeAOT/Rust ticks; grenade_air_ab matches 100. Together they cover grounded and aerial ThrowItem2 entry, charged release, slow-gravity aiming, aerial recoil/control and raycast landing, recoil/body split, delayed owner contact, held-position fuse expiry, deferred explosion, both startup shockwaves, first-frame self-kill, 90-frame lifetime, stock choice, fast respawn and landing. Terrain bounce, non-owner hits, duplication, and forced exits remain open.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.verification: Public rollout executes the measured QuickSpell cast/exit, active circle, deferred AirWave Shockwave, exact target capture, player/platform impulses, force curve, and entity observations; gust_ability_ab compares 360 complete NativeAOT/Rust ticks. Cross-ability targets expand with each concrete ability port.

abilities.name: Missile
abilities.verification: missile_ability_ab matches 500 exact NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded SparkShot entry, guided steering, stabilization, release, instability thrust, box/rounded collision resolution and correction, callback destruction, MineExplosion registration, one-shot Shockwave, first-frame lethal-box disable, and visual lifetime. Projectile/item/form collisions, time-stop and scale interactions, Item.Duplicate, and dedicated explosion-lethality scenarios remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Spike
abilities.verification: spike_ability_ab matches 500 exact NativeAOT/Rust ticks through grounded cast/recovery, far-side raycast placement, manual collider registration, down-thrust curve, persistent lethal box export, composite mass/inertia, cast impulse, neighboring-wall collision resolution and bilateral push. Recast replacement and dedicated player-lethality scenarios remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Smoke
abilities.verification: smoke_ability_ab matches 800 exact NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded ThrowItem2 entry, charged release, ballistic flight, the strict five-second fuse, all randomized cloud offsets and rotations, cloud registration, enter-radius animation, and persistent layer-22 entity export. Explosion ignition/chaining, scale changes, repeated-cast ring eviction, and Item.Duplicate still need dedicated goldens.

abilities.name: Revival
abilities.verification: Public rollout executes the measured QuickSpell cast/exit, active circle, deferred RevivePositionIndicator registration, exact shape-group observation order, marker replacement, and camera/water clamp; revival_ability_ab compares 650 complete NativeAOT/Rust ticks exactly. revival_death_ab compares 900 exact ticks through boundary death, hidden copied clone registration, distance-derived wisp/particle delay, marker removal, spawn animation and launch. Multiple simultaneous markers still require the general multi-clone rollout representation.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.verification: Public rollout plus composed actor runtime reproduce the instant cast, strict five-second expiry, player clocks/flags, 10,000-second live sentinel, six-second restoration, duplicate-slot chaining and telemetry. invisibility_ab matches NativeAOT for 637 ticks.

abilities.name: Mine
abilities.verification: mine_ability_ab matches 334 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through the original grounded ThrowItem form, deferred autonomous circle registration, hover, two-second arming, opponent scan/chase, player ignition, anticipation, jitter, owner-credited MineExplosion kill, first-frame hitbox disable, and stock recovery. Entity vector differences are bounded to 64 raw Q32 units after chase normalization and shockwave response; the form center differs by at most 5,000 raw units from PlayerPhysics ground reprojection. Item.Duplicate, scale changes, boundary effects, held-magnet behavior, and dedicated projectile/explosion ignition cases remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.verification: Exact public Q32 goldens cover the first-cast marker, release-to-ready second cast, single-caster transfer, two-way three-player area swap, disabled-object interval, four RNG samples per effect tick, reactivation, entity ordering and teammate spawn offsets for 300/450 ticks. Projectile/item/boulder targets remain pending on those entity ports.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.verification: rewind_ability_ab matches 300 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across recorded grounded and aerial movement, 150-tick history selection, 102-tick smootherstep/Catmull-Rom playback, input and physics suppression, platform raycast force, destination velocity/rotation/cooldown restoration, arrival depenetration and retained-ground release.

abilities.name: Gold mushroom
abilities.verification: Public rollout reproduces SuperStar's instant cast, next-pass effect initialization, four-second lifetime, airborne 0.85-strength jump override, 10,000-second live sentinel and five-second restored cooldown. gold_mushroom_ab matches NativeAOT exactly for 636 ticks.

abilities.name: Tack
abilities.verification: tack_ability_ab matches 1,450 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through aerial ThrowItem2 entry, charged release, deferred Projectile owner binding, ballistic landing, stable pinning and strict 20-second expiry. tack_kill_ab matches 400 ticks through the 0.8-second arm delay, owner-clear immunity, re-entry kill, updater-phase removal and stock-choice prefix. Item.Duplicate remains open.

abilities.name: Mjolnir
abilities.verification: mjolnir_ability_ab and mjolnir_wall_ab each match 1,450 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks. They cover aerial and grounded ThrowItem2 forms, charged release, deferred Projectile owner binding, signed spin, outbound drag, stall- and wall-clang return transitions, recall acceleration and speed clamp, repeated platform force, and owner catch. Victim hits and Item.Duplicate remain open.
